scheme: Do you charge for processing KYC?
section_title: Do you charge for processing KYC?
source_title: Do you charge for processing KYC?
text:
Do you charge for processing KYC? - At Groww, we charge NO FEES to process your KYC, making it hassle-free to get started.
You can begin your investment journey without worrying about any hidden fees or charges for KYC verification, ensuring a smooth and effortless process.

scheme: How to change password on Groww?
section_title: How to change password on Groww?
source_title: How to change password on Groww?
text:
How to change password on Groww? - To change your password:
1. Go to the 'Profile' section in the app.
2. Click on the 'Settings' icon.
3. Select 'Change Password'.
4. Enter your new password.
5. Click on 'Send OTP' to complete the process.

What are account opening charges? - Opening a Demat account on Groww is completely free.
You don’t have to pay anything to create the account, allowing you to start investing without any extra costs.
Start your investment journey without worrying about account opening charges.

scheme: When will the stocks be delivered to my demat account?
section_title: When will the stocks be delivered to my demat account?
source_title: When will the stocks be delivered to my demat account?
text:
When will the stocks be delivered to my demat account? - If you place a successful purchase order on the 'T' day (transaction day), the stocks will be delivered to your Demat account on 'T+1' working days.
Please note that this timeline does not include days when the market is closed, such as bank holidays, Exchange holidays, Saturdays, and Sundays.
For example, if your buy order is executed on a Friday, your holdings will be delivered to your Demat account by the end of Tuesday.
Additionally, the holdings will be delivered to your Demat account by Tuesday evening, provided you do not sell them on Monday or Tuesday before the delivery.

scheme: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
section_title: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
source_title: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
text:
Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'? - Any amount added to your Groww account is Available to Invest immediately.
However, it becomes Available to Withdraw only after 1 working day.
As per the NSE circular dated October 4, 2024, 100% of the delivery sell amount will be credited to your Stock & FnO Balance within 30 minutes of the sell transaction, making it available for further investment right away.
You can withdraw the full sell amount after 10 AM on the next trading day (T+1 day), which is the settlement day.

scheme: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
section_title: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
source_title: Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'?
text:
Why is my 'Available to Invest' not the same as my 'Available to Withdraw'? - You can withdraw the full sell amount after 10 AM on the next trading day (T+1 day), which is the settlement day.
In case of BTST trades (Buy Today, Sell Tomorrow) or selling pledged shares, the full sell amount will be blocked for the entire day and will only be withdrawable after 10 AM on the next settlement day (T+1).
Example: If you sell a stock on Friday, the full amount will be added to your Stock & FnO Balance within 30 minutes, and you can use it for investment. You can withdraw the full amount after 10 AM on Monday.
